title: Nortec (Condair) Fill Valve Assembly, 5-20 lbs/hr

comparisons.notes: Condair 2573515 SP fill valve 5-20 lbs, replaces older part 1312344 like the Woot item
Official Condair parts store, PN 2573515, 5-20 lbs

writeup: This is the Nortec (Condair) fill valve for 5-20 lb/hr electrode steam humidifiers, the replacement for older part 1312344 used in Condair EL and Nortec NH-series units. Woot has it new for $105.99, while HVAC parts sellers charge $195 to $258 for the same 2573515 assembly. A niche part, but a real saving if your humidifier needs one.
